description:
Full stack .NET Developer 
 Duration – 1 year + 
 Location – Columbus, OH 
 Need GC and USC 
 
 MUST BE LOCAL TO COLUMBUS, OH 
 Candidates must be strong with front end development. 
 
 Must have skills - .NET, MVC, HTML 5, JavaScript, CSS3 
 
 Description: 
 This posting is for an Interactive Developer. For Interactive developers, the primary emphasis is placed on how users interact with information, regardless of its source. Candidates should be uniquely qualified to design, develop and support web applications that: 
 
 1. Convey information from content owners in the most effective way 
 2. Efficiently send and receive data to back end systems in order to complete user transactions 
 3. Are capable of constant interface change due to user experience analysis 
 
 An Interactive Developer should have a broad range of expertise, spanning many disciplines. 
 
 Required Skills include: 
 
 - Comfortable with web site design and know how certain types of design elements affect the user interface 
 - Translate design elements from an image or design document to working HTML 
 - Ability to take wireframes and be able to create web pages that reflect the design of the wireframe 
 - Ability to take general concepts for the site and apply it without step by step instruction 
 - Expected to ensure that their website works properly and error-free and functions on any platform used to view it 
 - Have the ability to adapt wireframes and designs to account for varying viewport sizes 
 - Deep understanding of cascading style sheets, CSS3, templating concepts and methods, master pages and user controls 
 - Understanding of concepts such as master pages, div versus table layout, form design 
 - Understanding of server and client side coding techniques 
 - ASP.net WebForms using C# 4.x and above 
 - MVC is a plus 
 - Knowledge of JavaScript and JQuery 
 - Multiple tiered development 
 - Understanding of how web services relate to back end data stores and how data storage works within the presentation layer 
 
 - Technologies that are preferred: 
 HTML5 
 JavaScript 
 CSS3 
 ASP.net WebForms, C#, MVC 
 SQL Server 
 Visual Studio 2012+ 
 Subversion 
 Adobe Photoshop 


 If you are interested in the below position please forward your profile to preethib@usmsystems(dot)com or call me on 703 468 0398.
